Print or knit a figure

Source: R/basefigure.R
print.go_figure.Rd

Printing a figure renders it with plotly_widget() in the RStudio viewer or a browser. In R Markdown and Quarto documents, figures are rendered inline: as interactive widgets in HTML output, sized by the chunk options fig.width/fig.height (fig-width/fig-height in Quarto) unless the layout sets a size; and, for other formats (PDF, Word, ...), as static images made with save_image() when a browser is available.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'go_figure'
print(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'go_figure'
knit_print(x, ..., options = NULL)

Arguments

x

A go_figure object.

...

Passed on to the htmlwidget print or knit_print method.

options

Chunk options (from knitr).

Value

x, invisibly, for print().

Details

Set the chunk option plotly.static = TRUE to use static images in HTML output too, or plotly.static = FALSE to always use a widget.
